body_markdown:
CHANDLER, Ariz.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 6, 2026--


Everspin Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRAM), a leading developer and manufacturer of MRAM persistent memory solutions, will ring the Nasdaq Opening Bell on Thursday, October 8, 2026, in celebration of the company’s 10th anniversary as a Nasdaq-listed company. Everspin began trading on Nasdaq under the ticker MRAM on October 7, 2016.


The ceremony will begin at 9:30 a.m. EDT at the Nasdaq MarketSite in New York City and can be viewed live on Nasdaq’s Bell Ringing Ceremony page:[https://www.nasdaq.com/marketsite/bell-ringing-ceremony](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nasdaq.com%2Fmarketsite%2Fbell-ringing-ceremony&esheet=54616762&newsitemid=20261006861396&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nasdaq.com%2Fmarketsite%2Fbell-ringing-ceremony&index=1&md5=c7e5c05450ddfea8134181a63381e7d2) . Videos and photos from the ceremony will also be shared through Nasdaq’s social media channels.


“Ringing the Nasdaq Opening Bell is a meaningful milestone for Everspin and an opportunity to reflect on how far we’ve come,” said Sanjeev Aggarwal, president and CEO of Everspin Technologies. “Over the past 10 years, we have significantly expanded our product portfolio and addressable market, grown our customer base and continued to innovate in a rapidly evolving market. Most importantly, this milestone reflects the dedication of our employees and the support of their families, the trust of our customers and partners, and the support of our board and shareholders. We’re proud of what we’ve accomplished together and even more excited about the opportunities ahead as we enter the next chapter of our growth.”


The Nasdaq anniversary also comes as Everspin marks almost 20 years of commercial MRAM production. Since 2008, the company has significantly grown its MRAM portfolio and shipped products used across a wide range of applications, including data centers, industrial systems, automotive, aerospace and defense.


**About Everspin Technologies**


Everspin Technologies Inc. is the world’s leading provider of Magnetoresistive RAM (MRAM). Everspin MRAM delivers the industry’s most robust, highest-performance, non-volatile memory for Industrial IoT, Data Centers, and other mission-critical applications where data persistence is paramount. Headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Everspin provides commercially available MRAM solutions to a large and diverse customer base.
